Container.Name: Shelf
Container.Overview: A home for your books: catalog them, read EPUBs, PDFs, and comics in the browser, listen to audiobooks, and lend to the people you share it with. Syncs with KOReader, imports from Calibre, Audiobookshelf, and Goodreads, and finds free public-domain books. Open the web page and make the first account; it becomes the admin.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port Shelf's pages are on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, e-books, audiobooks, covers, and sign-in keys. Back this up.

Config.Name: Import folder
Config.Description: Optional: a folder whose books are added on their own, with a folder inside for each reader. Set Import:Folder below to /import as well.

Config.Name: Import:Folder
Config.Description: Set to /import to watch the import folder above.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user Shelf runs as: 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group Shelf runs as: 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: Allow new accounts
Config.Description: Set to false once everyone has an account.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when Shelf is reached only through a proxy such as Nginx Proxy Manager or SWAG.

Config.Name: Email server
Config.Description: An SMTP server, for password resets, loan reminders, and Send to Kindle. See the configuration docs for the rest.
